summary:
### Goal
Fix double-counted refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`; continue the ordered `payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3` rollout. Tenacity remains deferred.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small. Never edit `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`. `billing_v3` is active; never write to frozen `billing_v1`. Prefix new Sentry titles with `[billing]`; fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

### Key decisions and facts
Search rebuilds now use tenant-scoped queries, one shared embedder, 100-item batches, eight workers, and transactional bulk upserts. Added migration `0042` for unique `(tenant_id, document_id)`. Tenancy avoided the covering-index latency issue.

### Ruled out
Tenacity this sprint; invoice covering index.

### Progress
Migration job completed. Search tests pass; full suite: 247 passed, 4 skipped. Rebuild benchmark: 2.41s median vs 16.73s. Canary deployment was created with `2.8.0-rc.2`. CSV suite has one encoding failure.

### Next steps
Investigate reconciliation refunds and CSV failure. Verify canary image/version, then execute remaining rollout steps sequentially.

### Goal
Replace the hand-rolled retry loop in `ledgerly/sync/client.py` with Tenacity. Separately, execute the requested Kubernetes three-region staged rollout of `payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`, one ordered step at a time.

### Constraints and rules
Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`.

### Key decisions and facts
Worker memory repro: 7.3 MiB peak, 2.1 MiB retained, zero pending events; full suite previously passed (118 passed, 7 skipped). `self.completed_batches` is the only worker global retaining full payload dictionaries/customer metadata. CLI billing filters were consolidated into shared helpers; currency requires explicit `dest="currency"`. Parser abbreviation behavior must remain supported.

### Ruled out
No worker-related changes are currently needed based on available evidence. Duplicate currency argument definitions were removed.

### Progress
CLI cleanup completed: obsolete `args.filters` assertion updated; help shows one currency option; abbreviated `--curr/--sta` verified; 37 focused tests pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Added abbreviation regression test. Rollout has not started.

### Next steps
Implement and test Tenacity in `ledgerly/sync/client.py`. Run the eight Kubernetes rollout steps strictly in order, reporting/awaiting each before proceeding.
